title: CodexOrchestratorAnalysisEvidence
description: Use complete, self-contained sentences for prose and preserve exact file:line or source_id anchors, symbols, commands, and measured numbers. Omit internal codes, working shorthand, and invented labels. Explicitly disclose skipped checks, unverified claims, and unresolved blockers.

summary.description: State the outcome and its evidence in self-contained sentences. Identify skipped checks and unresolved uncertainty.

metric.description: Give the measured metric’s name and unit, expanding any source-specific abbreviation needed to identify it.

value.description: Record the exact measured value with its unit or state explicitly that the value is unverified.

source_location.description: Give the exact file:line, log record, or source_id anchor where the measurement appears.

notes.description: Explain the measurement conditions, limitations, or missing evidence in complete sentences.

dimension.description: Name the dimension being evaluated in plain technical language without an internal label.

expected.description: Describe the expected behavior or value and its conditions in a complete sentence.

observed.description: State what was actually observed in a complete sentence, including any missing or unverified measurement.

evidence_location.description: Give an exact file:line, log record, or source_id anchor. State explicitly when evidence is unavailable.

finding.description: Describe the observed anomaly and its scope in a self-contained sentence.

evidence_location.description: Give an exact file:line, log record, or source_id anchor. State explicitly when evidence is unavailable.

explanation.description: Explain the causal evidence and any unverified inference in complete sentences.

command.description: Record the exact command that ran, including arguments. Report skipped commands in the field for gaps instead of inventing a run.

key_output.description: State the observed result in a complete sentence, preserving exact measurements or relevant output excerpts.

items.description: Specify a concrete experiment and what it would verify in a self-contained sentence.
